Fig. 3. Candidate coverage, refinement, and delay robustness of VeriFuse. (a) Cooperative 3D AP70 versus initial-pool oracle coverage OC0 70 with the same frozen VLM arbiter and refinement disabled; n is the mean candidate count per cluster. (b) Refinement on positive clusters with OC0 50 = 0: Succ.50 measures recovery over the entire subset. (c) Vehicle-side BEV AP50 on the same 1,592 common valid frames at RSU delays of 0, 100, 300, and 500 ms. The gray dashed line marks the vehicle-only baseline (0.612). Percentage labels show relative AP decreases from 0 to 300 ms.

Fig. 2. Overview of VeriFuse. Source-conditioned proposals form one mixed pool; the VLM selects, rejects, or returns one anchor–reason–token tuple, while deterministic compilation and re-verification bound geometric execution.

Fig. 4. Illustration of VeriFuse on DAIR-V2X-C camera images. Box overlays illustrate the decision paths: (a) vehicle-only and (b) infrastructure-only detections; (c) the mixed candidate pool; (d) SELECT of an adequate candidate; (e,f) an inadmissible REJECT response for a vehicle-supported cluster, followed by fallback to its original vehicle proposal; (g) a REFINE diagnosis of a center offset; and (h) the refined box after deterministic compilation.
